title: Reasoning routine for future Security Effect work
summary: When extending Bouncer, first identify the observation/evidence, then the action being attempted, then the deterministic policy interpretation, then the downstream authority/enforcement seam. Do not collapse these layers or invent runtime model authority.
invariants: Ask what is observed before asking what should happen.
Attach concern to the proposed action and consequence, not the person.
Preserve counterevidence, unknowns, freshness and provenance.
If interpretation becomes operative institutional policy, make it fixed/versioned/reviewable.
If execution authority is needed, route through the owning authority component rather than granting it in Security Effect.
For staged/long operations, revalidate at irreversible commit.
procedure: 1. Identify exact evidence sources and temporal validity.
2. Define the exact action/capability surface and consequence.
3. Produce findings with support, counterevidence and unknowns.
4. Evaluate under an exact fixed policy identity and retain trace.
5. Map disposition to capability constraints/review work without fabricating authority.
6. Bind exact live invocation to Access Permissions where method authority is required.
7. Revalidate continuation at commit for irreversible operations.
8. Add executable acceptance tests for both constrained and unaffected abilities.

provenance.claim: Architecture provides the evidence -> assessment -> authority/enforcement composition used by this reasoning routine.
